label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
@Rohan fair question da. You have every right to ask. Divya asking over dinner is honestly more due diligence than one of my investors did, so no offence taken.

I’m not going to do a founder speech. Straight answer: it’s not all good, and it’s not dead. Your money is at risk. I’m not going to tell you it’s safe because I genuinely don’t know that, and you trusted me with real money.

What happened: last Friday we let go 6 of 14. Gave everyone 2 months’ pay and I’ve already got 4 of them interviews. Firing people was the worst day of my life, worse than failing maths in 2nd sem, and I’m not joking about that one. On 28 Oct the Hyderabad fund bridge round fell through. Term sheet was basically ready. The partner said “we love the energy” on the call and then stopped replying for 11 days. I’ve been ghosted before, but not by someone who was about to send money.

Where it stands: runway is about 5 months after the cuts. Not infinite, but not zero. App is around 41k monthly users. Plumbers and electricians side is growing. AC servicing is bleeding money, so we’re shutting it. The plan now is housing society tie-ups. We’ve already signed pilots with 3 societies in HSR. That’s the bet. I think we have a real shot. Real shot, not a sure thing. Anyone who tells you otherwise is selling something.

Your and Divya’s 3 lakh was in the 2025 friends round, same terms as everyone else. I haven’t forgotten that. I can’t promise it back, but I can promise you won’t find out about the next twist from my LinkedIn. If the society thing works, there’s a path. If it doesn’t, I’ll tell you straight.

Let’s do a proper call this week, you and Divya. I’ll show you the numbers — runway, pipeline, the lot. Ask the ugly questions. Better that than you two doing maths over dinner.

Sneha, I’m breathing. Mostly. Amma asked last week if TCS is still hiring, so even my mother has stress-tested the plan. Security uncle now asks “masala or plain” before I sit down, so at least someone is getting product feedback.

Ajay, the cricket captain line was unfair. Losing captains get a guard of honour. I got a LinkedIn comment from a guy selling SEO.

Saturday I’m coming. Pranav is buying. I’ll be the one eating dosa and pretending not to check email.

Rohan, keep the sad face on standby, but don’t book the funeral hall. We’re not okay-okay, but we’re not done.
